name: Containers
description: Manage your Docker engine (Colima, Docker Desktop, OrbStack, Podman, Rancher Desktop or any Docker context) and the Compose stacks, containers, ports and logs of the active worktree from Orca's right sidebar.

screenshots.caption: Logs and shell from the All view
